summary:
We are from Blue Phoenix Team 2, Al Mahd School. Our challenge is "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer". The goal is to create an interactive game that lets students run a lunar or Martian outpost, balancing competing demands like life support, radiation shielding, power, and food production so they experience firsthand the decisions 
that determine whether a mission fails or succeeds.
